settings.inactiveHelp: Set the HF_TOKEN environment variable on the server (a Hugging Face token with Inference Providers permission), then restart the backend.
settings.privacy: When the assistant is used, questions, relevant document passages, and looked-up data are sent to model providers through Hugging Face. Knowledge vectors are stored in the Neravoxa database.
